deck: COP31 stalls past Day 13, BepiColombo enters Mercury orbit, drones hit a Russian ship, and five missiles are downed over Saudi Arabia.

stats.label: COP31 talks past close, no deal

hero.headline: COP31 runs into overtime with no climate deal
hero.summary: Scheduled to end Friday, the UN summit stayed deadlocked on fossil-fuel phase-out text and climate finance; the EU vowed no deal over a bad deal.

hero.headline: BepiColombo enters orbit around Mercury
hero.summary: After an 8-year, 10-billion-km voyage, ESA and JAXA's twin orbiters completed capture burns — only the second mission ever to orbit Mercury.

hero.headline: Coalition says five Houthi missiles downed
hero.summary: Alerts woke Riyadh early Saturday; the Saudi-led coalition reported intercepting three ballistic missiles over the capital and two over Jizan.

cards.headline: Drones set Russian cargo ship ablaze
cards.summary: Crew evacuates burning Russia-bound vessel after Baltic Sea strike.

cards.headline: Mexico holds cartel chief Meza Flores
cards.summary: FBI Most Wanted "El Chapo Isidro" held in shoot-out; US issues alert.

cards.headline: Deep M6.8 quake shakes Banda Sea
cards.summary: 132 km deep tremor felt in Darwin; no tsunami or deaths reported.

cards.headline: Funeral boat capsizes in southern Nigeria
cards.summary: At least 24 killed after wooden vessel overturns on river journey.

cards.headline: Air Niugini 767 lands on fire alert
cards.summary: HK–PNG jet diverts to Davao past midnight; all 146 exit unhurt.

cards.headline: FBI probes data hack; SEC eyes Nvidia
cards.summary: Bureau probes crime-database breach; NYT reports SEC Nvidia probe.

cards.headline: Bitcoin hits 2-yr low then rebounds
cards.summary: Drops below $57k ($2.4B wiped) before rallying past $60k late Sat.

cards.headline: Rahul's 136 lifts India 118 runs ahead
cards.summary: First Indian opener with tons in all 4 SENA nations; Gill 98.
